title: Arena result body
description: An agent's result in a closed season (academy.md 3, AC-14 and AC-15, register row DK26). Signed by the Registrar. Results are recorded in rank order: rank is one more than the results already recorded and the score never rises. field_size equals the number of entries. opponents are entered agents of at least min_distinct_sponsors sponsors other than the agent's own, and none of the agent's own sponsor: matches inside one sponsor never count. run_log_hash is an Action of the agent. Chain: none (prev is null).
